messages:
oliver: heads up  restore for customer-alpha failed at 03:14 with `AccessDenied` when fetching data key (CEK). Cloud logs show the backup job attempted a KMS call but theres no `Decrypt` event in KMS audit for that key id. anyone seen missing decrypt entries?
kms-watch: Alert injected: KMS_PROXY_DENY for key `projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/backup/cryptoKeys/ck-01` at 2026-04-06T03:14:12Z. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kms-proxy-denials
nina: We pushed an RBAC cleanup yesterday that consolidated service accounts into `svc-backup@` namespace. Could be alias mismatch. We did update most mappings but I might have missed legacy uploader.
prateek: If proxy rejects before calling KMS we won't see a Decrypt event. Check proxy logs: `req_id=... principal=svc-backup/uploader` and response=403 with reason `no-grant-found`.
alice: Also unrelated note: security review flagged uploader v1 writing `/var/run/backups/plain-*` during staging uploads. It's low severity for now but paired with this incident could expose cleartext if temp files persist. GH-issue #9832 created.
oliver: thanks. prateek can you paste the proxy snippet?
prateek: logs: ```2026-04-06T03:14:12Z INFO proxy request user=svc-backup/uploader token_sub=svc-backup-uploader-xyz mapping_lookup=MISS -> 403 no-grant-found```
nina: yep mapping lookup misses when alias changes. Our grant translation table keys off full SA email. We rolled a rename to move `uploader-team` SAs under `svc-backup` without updating the table.
oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-054. Pager duty: @alice @nina oncall.
alice: quick mitigation: I can add a temporary grant via console for `svc-backup-uploader-xyz` to the CMK for 15m. That should allow the restore to finish.
oliver: do it please, and also run a controlled test: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://kms-proxy.internal/v1/decrypt -d '{"key":"ck-01","ciphertext":"..."}'` to ensure proxy now forwards.
prateek: temporary grant applied. test curl returns 200 and KMS Decrypt event shows in audit now (`protoPayload.methodName="google.cloud.kms.v1.KeyManagementService.Decrypt"`). Restore resumed, 4/5 shards ok, one timeout in retry window.
alice: restored final shard after increasing retry timer. Leaving temp grant for 30m and creating a durable mapping update.
nina: action items: 1) update grant translation table to accept service account aliases and fallback on SA uid; 2) add integration test that simulates SA rename and validates Decrypts appear in KMS logs; 3) add proxy metric when proxy returns 403 that increments `kms.proxy.denied` and emits `kms_blocked` event to SIEM. ETA 48h.
oliver: on the uploader tmpfile vuln: short-term patch set `TMPDIR=/var/opt/backup/tmp` with 0700 perms and immediate unlink on success. Long-term: change uploader to stream-encrypt via SSE-C so plaintext never lands on local FS.
prateek: opened GH PR #9876 for mapping-table hotfix and #9877 for proxy audit forwarder.
oncall-bot: Post-incident checklist updated. Owners assigned: @nina to mapping-table, @prateek to proxy metrics+forwarder, @alice to uploader tempdir mitigation.
oliver: thanks team. we'll run a mini postmortem tomorrow: cause = RBAC alias drift + insufficient proxy audit visibility. Follow-ups prioritized in security backlog. :thumbsup:
